reason: Adds configurable provider and model fallback orchestration for agent-loop requests when eligible failures such as rate limits or quota errors occur.

summaries.zh: 为智能体循环提供可配置的提供商和模型故障转移链，在符合条件的限流或配额错误发生时切换到备用模型。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable provider and model fallback chain for the agent loop, switching to backup models when eligible errors such as rate limits or quota failures occur.

capabilities: Intercepts eligible model request failures in the agent loop
Routes retries to an ordered chain of configured providers and models
Persists the selected fallback according to step, turn, or session scope
